trailheadDirection: From Seattle take Interstate 90 east over the Columbia River past Vantage to exit 143, turn left onto Silica Road, pass beneath the freeway, then turn left at the first chance onto Vantage Road and follow it 1.4 miles down the canyon to parking on the left. trailheadDirection: From Interstate 90 take exit 42 for Tinkham Road and drive a short distance southwest. In winter park at the turnaround beside the highway maintenance facility; the summer trailhead is further along and a Northwest Forest Pass applies there.
approach: From the Tinkham Road turnaround by the highway maintenance facility, walk the short snow-covered road to the McClellan Butte trailhead and continue up the trail. trailheadDirection: From Leavenworth, follow Icicle Road about 8.5 miles and turn left onto Eightmile Road (Forest Road 7600); bear right onto Forest Road 7601 and go roughly 4 miles to the trailhead. A day-use fee of $5 per vehicle applies. Forest Road 7601 is closed to vehicles every winter.
approach: From the Stuart Lake Trailhead (Trail #1599), follow the trail to the lake and continue to its west end. Push on through forest for about a quarter mile to a big open meadow, where the ice lines sit on your left below the north face of the mountain. In winter, with the road shut, the walk starts back at the closure and is much longer.

trailheadDirection: Head northwest from the Mazama store on Lost River Road for 1.5 miles and pull into the big lot on the right-hand side. The lot is on private land that climbers may use by permission, so do not camp there.
approach: From the Fun Rocks parking lot, follow the Spokane Gulch trail toward Mazama, bearing right at the base of Fun Rock. After the A-Wall the trail reaches a broad bench high above the valley. Just before the trail swings east, leave it and go north toward a patch of trees; a faint track over some rotten logs leads to the crag.
